stations.note: Q-CLUSTER3: hard fabric station tiles (qc_stn_kit.py masters), origins on the 4.32 lattice; >= 8.64-um channels in A / T / B / row gaps, 4.32 to the A0 face and the cluster edge in L / R; R0 = word flows north (d S, q N), MX = south; xstn = tap E, xstnw = tap W (both R0)

die_crossing.rule: (a) + (c): no die link crosses a qfd_c_b8n_dv outline (die repeaters never sit inside it; M9 over the cluster carries die PG only in dv2r8f).  Die links run in the band gaps, the slice / head row and the W column; the only data that passes through a cluster is its own registered feedthroughs bc -> bco (2 x 516 b, 25 edges) and rs_i -> rs_o (514 b, 28 edges).  No die feedthrough repeater sites are reserved.

regional_resets.rule: Q-CB16RST (10-19): 8 die-delivered regional resets rst_<q> (pin beside ck_<q>); pin register u_fab.u_rpin_<q> on ck_<q> at the region entry nearest the pin; in-region trees only (corridor / channel lanes, never over the A0 tile); every tile / xstn rst_n exactly reset edges after its region pin, every landing half at the landing's reset_depth.  Die obligation: release all 8 of an instance on the SAME calendar edge (each timed against its own region tree, the die reset tree lands each); MUT 8 (bench) = one region one edge late.

far_position: ONE master: in the far bands (0 / 3) rs_i is a declared-idle terminus tied to the instance's own tie_lo by the die (valid bit 0 every cycle) and rs_o is left unconnected (output only)
gating: A0 views qfd_tile_nk_romleaf_a0 / nl twin not CLOSED (Q-ROMPARENT-2): diagnostics only, no binding

landings.rule: every region-seam crossing landed (Q-CLUSTER-LANDALL, coordinator 0fy; Q-CB16RST 10-19: no reset hop crosses a seam: 8 die-delivered regional resets rst_<q>, each registered at its region entry with an in-region tree)
landings.window_ps: (2 - 4) T + t_hold < dL < 2 T - t_cq - t_setup (T = 833.3: about -1666 .. +1666 ps)
landings.epochs: released reset (L3): each half's rsi = a run in its OWN region's reset tree (from rst_<q>), both halves at the landing's common depth after their pins; the die releases the 8 rst_<q> on the same calendar edge: G == R0, E = K
landings.fault: assertion only ($error LAND_FAULT in simulation; synthesis drops the epoch tags)
